corrections.old_text: ሉቃ ፱ ፴፭ ፤ ፪ ጴጥ ፩ ፲፯ ።
corrections.corrected_text: ሉቃ ፫ ፳፪ ፤ ፪ ጴጥ ፩ ፲፯ ።
corrections.reason: The printed cross-reference clearly reads 'ሉቃ ፫ ፳፪' (Luke 3:22, the Baptism of Jesus), which was misread as '፱ ፴፭'.

corrections.old_text: ም ሂደ አለ። አዳም ከዚህ ዓ↵
corrections.corrected_text: ም ሄደ አለ። አዳም ከዚህ ዓ↵
corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 5th-order (ኀምስ) ring at the base of the right leg ('ሄደ', went), not 3rd-order 'ሂደ'.
The printed word is 'ፆሩን' (his warfare/temptation, matching 'ፆር' in lines 13, 15, and 23), where the top loop of 'ፆ' was misread as 'የ'.
In the Ge'ez citation 'ንሣእ ፩ደ መዓደ እምአፍአ', the accusative noun is printed in the 1st/4th order 'መዓደ' without a 7th-order loop.
The negative verb 'አላመጣውም' (parallel to line 27 'አላመጣውም') is printed with 4th-order 'ላ' ('አላመ-'), not 1st-order 'ለ'.
The printed glyph at the start of line 4 is 'ነሣው' (from 'ድል ቢነሣው') with 'ሣ' (ንጉሥ ሠ), not 'ሳ'.
